RATIONALE: Same subject (the binary) seen by a new speaker — additive reveal inside the established frame, not a new scene. EDITING_DNA: content changes within a locked frame.

RATIONALE: Subject changes from the binary model to a physical comparison of two drinks. Concept change = hard cut (DECISION_RULES §1).

VISUAL_NEED: More stimulation marks over the can than over the mug
RATIONALE: Same two objects already on screen; only the comparative quantity changes. Additive reveal.

RATIONALE: Still the same comparison frame; one more attribute added to the can. Not a new scene.
